description:
## Why

PKIX-xj81 decomposition, pattern 5 of 6. Real-world CMS message certBags
include certificates that have no role in any path: other-CA intermediates,
expired self-signed leaves, EE certs from unrelated chains. The builder must
walk the right path through this noise without timing out or being misled.

## What

Pool topology:

```
StressRoot ── signs ── GoodIntermediate ── signs ── CmsBagEE
Noise: OtherCa1Intermediate (signed by a different unknown root),
       ExpiredSelfSignedLeaf (expired, self-signed, irrelevant DN),
       UnrelatedEE (a totally separate chain EE),
       DuplicateOfGoodIntermediate (byte-identical clone of
       GoodIntermediate to test dedup).
```

Build steps:

1. Generator issues seven DER fixtures (root, good intermediate, EE, plus
   the four noise certs).
2. Test (`tests/cms_bag_pool.rs`):
   - Pool inserts all four noise certs first, then GoodIntermediate.
   - `build_path` must succeed in bounded time and return a chain
     containing only GoodIntermediate (no noise certs in the chain).
   - Assert the chain length is exactly the minimum (3: EE, intermediate,
     anchor surrogate).
   - `validate_path` succeeds.
3. Also verify that duplicate detection (DuplicateOfGoodIntermediate) does
   not cause cycles or duplicate-insert errors.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Seven DER fixtures committed.
- [ ] Generation reproducible via `generate.sh`.
- [ ] One integration test verifying noise-tolerant path building.

## Depends on

PKIX-xj81.1.
title: pkix-path-builder: CMS-bag-shaped pool with irrelevant noise fixture+test
